title: Happy sheep
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="70" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#5a3d7a"/>
  <rect x="44" y="70" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#5a3d7a"/>
  <rect x="58" y="70" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#5a3d7a"/>
  <rect x="70" y="70" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#5a3d7a"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="29" y="85" width="9" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8a6bb5"/>
  <rect x="43" y="85" width="9" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8a6bb5"/>
  <rect x="57" y="85" width="9" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8a6bb5"/>
  <rect x="69" y="85" width="9" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8a6bb5"/>
  <!-- body wool cloud -->
  <g fill="#f5f0ff">
    <circle cx="38" cy="55" r="16"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="48" r="18"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="55" r="16"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="66" r="14"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="66" r="14"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="60" r="16"/>
  </g>
  <!-- wool highlights -->
  <g fill="#ffffff">
    <circle cx="46" cy="42" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="46" r="5"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="5"/>
    <circle cx="68" cy="52" r="5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- head wool -->
  <g fill="#f5f0ff">
    <circle cx="25" cy="40" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="48" r="9"/>
    <circle cx="14" cy="38" r="8"/>
    <circle cx="24" cy="30" r="8"/>
  </g>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="48" rx="11" ry="10" fill="#7a5aaa"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="10" cy="40" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#7a5aaa" transform="rotate(-30 10 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="40" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#7a5aaa" transform="rotate(30 34 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="10" cy="40" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#c9a8e8" transform="rotate(-30 10 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="40" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#c9a8e8" transform="rotate(30 34 40)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="46" r="2.8" fill="#2d1b4e"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="46" r="2.8" fill="#2d1b4e"/>
  <circle cx="19" cy="45" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="45" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="51" r="2.5" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="51" r="2.5" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M18 52 Q22 57 27 52" stroke="#2d1b4e" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- topknot wool -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="27" r="6" fill="#f5f0ff"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="27" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
